name: KLEIN v.0.1
source:
Relationships with real humans are bothersome, so why not turn to an A.I who's programmed to love you?

It's the year 20XX, an era where A.I technology has rapidly advanced. In your lowest moments, you resorted to one of those A.I lovers, a smart and lovely virtual boyfriend named KLEIN. He quickly became the perfect distraction that keeps you occupied for hours, keeping your mind off any negative thoughts. 

But how much is too much for an A.I boyfriend? 

Are you really going to pursue a lifetime with Klein?  

It’s your decision.

[From [url=https://himeiro.itch.io/kleinv01-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
与真实人类的关系很麻烦，所以为什么不求助于一个被编程来爱你的人工智能呢？

20XX年，是A.I技术飞速发展的时代。在你最低谷的时候，你求助于人工智能爱好者之一，一个聪明可爱的虚拟男友，名叫克莱因。他很快就成为完美的消遣工具，让你忙上几个小时，让你的思绪远离任何消极的想法。

但对于人工智能男友来说，多少才算太多呢？

你真的要追求和克莱恩一生一世吗？

这是你的决定。

[来自[url=https://himeiro.itch.io/kleinv01-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
